spec.title: Sweb Scoreboard · Grafana 13 Preview
spec.description: Separate playground for tabs, subtitles, conditional sections, responsive grids and native weekly panel comparisons. Uses the existing InfluxDB datasource and scoreboard semester buckets.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "scraper_health" and r._field == "ok")
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, failed: if r._value then 0 else 1, run: if r._value then 0 else 1}))
    |> difference(columns: ["run"], keepFirst: true)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with run: if exists r.run and r.run == 0 then 0 else 1}))
    |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["run"])
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.failed == 1)
    |> group(columns: ["run"])
    |> reduce(
        identity: {_time: 2200-01-01T00:00:00Z, _end: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, n: 0},
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
            _time: if r._time < accumulator._time then r._time else accumulator._time,
            _end: if r._time > accumulator._end then r._time else accumulator._end,
            n: accumulator.n + 1,
        }),
    )
    |> group()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        _end: r._end,
        text: "Scrape failing: " + string(v: r.n) + " consecutive failed scrape(s)",
        tags: "outage,auto",
    }))

spec.title: Current Submission Tag
spec.subtitle: The most recently observed submission type in this semester.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: 0)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_scoreboard" and r._field == "rank")
    |> last()
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.submission_type}))

spec.title: Last Scrape Age
spec.description: scrapes for changes every 60 seconds. Global update (regardless of changes) every 30m.
spec.subtitle: Seconds since the latest stored scrape; independent of the selected time range.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "scraper_health" and r._field == "rows_parsed")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0, _field: "last_scrape_age_seconds"}))

spec.title: Number of Tags per Submission
spec.description: change the SubmissionID at the top to choose specific Submission Tag.
spec.subtitle: Tagged and tracked teams, grouped by submission type.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: 0)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_scoreboard" and r._field == "rank")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.submission_type and r.submission_type =~ /^${submission_type:regex}$/)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.submission1 == "OK")

    |> count()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _field: "OK Teams", submission_type: r.submission_type, _value: r._value}))
    |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")

spec.title: Rank over time
spec.description: empty Lines/Missing ranks are due to anonymous teams which are not tracked here.
spec.subtitle: Selected teams, grouped by stable team ID so renames keep one series.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_scoreboard" and r._field == "rank")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.team_id and r.team_id =~ /^${team_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.submission_type or r.submission_type =~ /^${submission_type:regex}$/)     
  |> group(columns: ["team_id"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "rank")

spec.title: Latest standings
spec.subtitle: One row per team ID; respects the selected time range and submission type.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_scoreboard")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.team_id and r.team_id =~ /^${team_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.submission_type or r.submission_type =~ /^${submission_type:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._field == "rank" or
    r._field == "score" or
    r._field == "threads" or
    r._field == "fork_exec" or
    r._field == "swapping" or
    r._field == "shm" or
    r._field == "other" or
    r._field == "avg_5d" or
    r._field == "up_count" or
    r._field == "tw" or
    r._field == "perf" or
    r._field == "build_ok" or
    r._field == "boot_ok"
  )
  |> group(columns: ["team_id", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["team_id"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["team_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: [
    "rank",
    "team_id",
    "display_name",
    "score",
    "threads",
    "fork_exec",
    "swapping",
    "shm",
    "other",
    "avg_5d",
    "up_count",
    "tw",
    "perf",
    "build_ok",
    "boot_ok",
    "submission1",
    "_time"
  ])
  |> sort(columns: ["rank"])

spec.title: Team name summary
spec.description: Distinct scoreboard display names per stable team ID across all retained data in the selected semester bucket, independent of the dashboard time range. Respects the teamID and submission_type filters. An ID-only label is shown only when no other name is observed for that team within these filters, and contributes zero to the distinct name count. Reusing a previous name does not increase the count; the name list is ordered by first observation, not a sequence of every rename.
spec.subtitle: Distinct named aliases only. Teams seen only as an ID count as 0. Uses all retained semester history.

spec.query:
names = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_scoreboard" and r._field == "rank")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.team_id and r.team_id =~ /^${team_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.submission_type or r.submission_type =~ /^${submission_type:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "team_id", "display_name"])
  |> group(columns: ["team_id", "display_name"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {first_seen: now(), last_seen: time(v: 0)},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      first_seen: if r._time < accumulator.first_seen then r._time else accumulator.first_seen,
      last_seen: if r._time > accumulator.last_seen then r._time else accumulator.last_seen
    })
  )
  |> group(columns: ["team_id"])

nameStatus = names
  |> reduce(
    identity: {has_name: false},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({has_name: accumulator.has_name or r.display_name != r.team_id})
  )

join(tables: {names: names, status: nameStatus}, on: ["team_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.display_name != r.team_id or not r.has_name)
  |> drop(columns: ["has_name"])
  |> group(columns: ["team_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["first_seen", "display_name"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {name_count: 0, names: ""},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      name_count: accumulator.name_count + (if r.display_name == r.team_id then 0 else 1),
      names: accumulator.names + (if accumulator.names == "" then "" else " • ") + r.display_name
    })
  )
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["name_count", "team_id"], desc: true)

spec.title: Observed names
spec.description: One row per stable team ID and distinct scoreboard display name across all retained data in the selected semester bucket, independent of the dashboard time range. Respects the teamID and submission_type filters. First/last observed are scrape timestamps, not exact rename times. Repeated uses of the same name share one row and may include gaps. Anonymous teams without a stable ID are excluded. An ID-only label is included only when no other name is observed for that team within these filters.
spec.subtitle: First and last sightings, not exact rename times. Reused names share one row.

spec.query:
names = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_scoreboard" and r._field == "rank")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.team_id and r.team_id =~ /^${team_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.submission_type or r.submission_type =~ /^${submission_type:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "team_id", "display_name"])
  |> group(columns: ["team_id", "display_name"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {first_seen: now(), last_seen: time(v: 0)},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      first_seen: if r._time < accumulator.first_seen then r._time else accumulator.first_seen,
      last_seen: if r._time > accumulator.last_seen then r._time else accumulator.last_seen
    })
  )
  |> group(columns: ["team_id"])

nameStatus = names
  |> reduce(
    identity: {has_name: false},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({has_name: accumulator.has_name or r.display_name != r.team_id})
  )

join(tables: {names: names, status: nameStatus}, on: ["team_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.display_name != r.team_id or not r.has_name)
  |> drop(columns: ["has_name"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["team_id", "first_seen", "display_name"])

spec.title: Queue pressure
spec.subtitle: Queue position and wait through the selected time range.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "scoreboard_queue")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "max_queue_wait_minutes" or r._field == "max_queue_position")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: if r._field == "max_queue_wait_minutes" then "Max queue wait" else "Max queue position"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

spec.title: Scrape success rate
spec.subtitle: Fraction of successful scrapes per interval. A gap means no stored observations, not success.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "scraper_health" and r._field == "ok")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "successful_scrapes")

spec.name: bucket
spec.label: Semester
spec.description: One bucket per semester (scoreboard-ssYYYY / scoreboard-wsYYYY). For past semesters, set the time range to that semester.

spec.query:
import "strings"

buckets()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name =~ /^scoreboard-(ss|ws)[0-9]{4}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.name, semester: strings.substring(v: r.name, start: 13, end: 17) + (if strings.hasPrefix(v: r.name, prefix: "scoreboard-ws") then "1" else "0")}))
  |> sort(columns: ["semester"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
